Introduction

Jang Gyuri is a South Korean singer and actress currently signed with Namoo Actors. She is a former member of the girl group fromis_9 which was formed through the show "Idol School". Placing 9th in the finale, and securing her spot in the group, she officially debuted with the mini-album "To. Heart" on January 24, 2018.

Despite having debuted only a few months earlier, she competed in the survival show Produce 48. However, she was eliminated after ranking 25th overall.

She officially left fromis_9 in July of 2022
